description: The first prompt-envelope-v1 schema draft omitted the closing brace for the diagnostics array property. The inherited workspace validator rejected the schema before any v0.09 benchmark or contract was frozen.
resolution: Close the diagnostics property, reparse both schemas, rerun workspace validation, and only then construct the frozen corpus.
regression_action: No new runtime regression; existing schema-document validation already detected the defect at the correct boundary.
